system.description:
• Effect: Once per encounter, in any combat, call upon noble spirit — target's AC is reduced by the knight's Charisma modifier, the knight has Advantage on the attack, and doubles the weapon's damage dice (flat modifiers are not doubled).
  • Usable once per encounter, against a single target

activities.name: Honour Attack
activities.text: Reduce the target's AC by your Charisma modifier, attack with Advantage and double the weapon's damage dice.
